[PREFERENCE] User is looking for healthy snack ideas to curb sweet cravings.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been trying to make better choices in their diet.  
[PREFERENCE] User made a fruit salad with grapes, strawberries, and pineapple, topped with whipped cream.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fruit salad with whipped cream is a great start, but whipped cream is still a treat.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested healthy snack ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Fresh Fruit Kebabs: Skewer fresh fruits like strawberries, grapes, kiwi, and pineapple.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Dried Fruit and Nut Mix: Combine dried fruits like cranberries, apricots, and raisins with nuts like almonds and walnuts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Homemade Trail Mix: Mix rolled oats, nuts, seeds, and dried fruits, with optional dark chocolate chips.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. No-Bake Energy Balls: Oat-based energy balls with honey, peanut butter, and chocolate chips.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Greek Yogurt with Fresh Fruit and Honey: Combine non-fat Greek yogurt with fresh fruits and honey.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Apple Slices with Almond Butter: Spread almond butter on apple slices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Cinnamon Banana Toast: Toast whole-grain bread, spread with mashed banana, and sprinkle with cinnamon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Chia Seed Pudding: Mix chia seeds with almond milk, honey, and vanilla extract, then refrigerate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Dark Chocolate-Dipped Fruit: Dip fruits into melted dark chocolate (at least 70% cocoa).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Homemade Granola: Make granola with rolled oats, nuts, seeds, and honey.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Portion control is key, even with healthier snack options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a simple recipe for No-Bake Energy Balls with the following ingredients:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 cups rolled oats
